AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN.surface: POST /api/chat only. The chat_knowledge MCP tool needs no guard of its own — MCP tools are reachable ONLY through app.all('/mcp'), which refuses before dispatch, so a second one there would be a duplicate derivation of a decision already made.
AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN.note: This is the `authRequired` body shape (webhook-api.ts), EXTENDED with new `code` values rather than a second shape invented for this route. A REST surface, so 401 — /mcp answers 200 + a JSON-RPC error instead, because a 401 there starts MCP OAuth discovery against a server we do not run.
AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN.fires_on: a well-formed API key (av_live_/av_free_ + 24 hex) that exists in neither Stripe nor free_keys. NOT retryable — a settled fact.
AUTH_KEY_UNKNOWN.precedes_metering: Yes. The refusal runs before chatQuotaApiKey/rateLimit.check, so a refused caller is never charged the chat meter for being refused.

AUTH_UPSTREAM_INDETERMINATE.surface: POST /api/chat only. The chat_knowledge MCP tool needs no guard of its own — MCP tools are reachable ONLY through app.all('/mcp'), which refuses before dispatch, so a second one there would be a duplicate derivation of a decision already made.
AUTH_UPSTREAM_INDETERMINATE.note: This is the `authRequired` body shape (webhook-api.ts), EXTENDED with new `code` values rather than a second shape invented for this route. A REST surface, so 401 — /mcp answers 200 + a JSON-RPC error instead, because a 401 there starts MCP OAuth discovery against a server we do not run.
AUTH_UPSTREAM_INDETERMINATE.fires_on: a well-formed key we could not verify because the billing upstream was unreachable or unconfigured. RETRYABLE — it is the absence of an answer, never a rejection, and the copy never says 'invalid'.

error_contract._kill_switch: AUTH_STRICT_UNKNOWN=0 restores the pre-wave behaviour on every surface at once (both codes above stop firing and the caller is served the free tier). Default is ON.

cache_contract.rationale: Chat answers are LLM-synthesized — replaying the same answer for 24h saves repeat-call cost without staling (knowledge bundle is the source of truth and the underlying search results are themselves 1h-cached). HTTP cache disabled so downstream proxies don't share answers across api_keys.

consumers: Cursor IDE / Claude Code / Claude Desktop MCP clients asking 'how do I' questions
embedded help widgets on landing pages
drift_check_command: curl -fsS -X POST https://api.algovault.com/api/chat -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"question":"how do I get a BTC trade signal"}' | jq -e 'has("question") and has("answer") and has("citations") and has("model") and has("_algovault") and (has("usage") | not) and (has("prompt_tokens") | not) and (has("outcome_return_pct") | not) and (has("system_prompt") | not)' > /dev/null && echo DRIFT_CHECK_OK || echo DRIFT_CHECK_FAIL

auth_shape.outcome: 'ABSENT' | 'MALFORMED' | 'UNKNOWN' | 'INDETERMINATE' | 'RESOLVED' — the SAME vocabulary the resolver decided with (single derivation, src/lib/credential-outcome.ts). Normally one of the three SERVED values; the two refusing ones appear only under AUTH_STRICT_UNKNOWN=0, where an UNKNOWN key is served and the honest thing to report is UNKNOWN.
auth_shape.presented: boolean — whether a credential was presented at all. `presented:true` with `tier:'free'` is the whole diagnosis for an unexpanded ${env:AV_API_KEY}.
auth_shape.tier: the tier actually served, so a caller can compare it against the one they pay for
auth_shape.omitted_when: never on a served response. A REFUSED call (UNKNOWN / INDETERMINATE with the strict switch on) returns a JSON-RPC error and has no envelope at all.
auth_shape.why_it_exists: A well-formed but non-existent key was served the free tier with HTTP 200 and no signal, so the only support advice available was 'read _algovault.quota.total, and if it says 200 your key did not work' — inferring auth state from a QUOTA number, which correlates today and would stop correlating the moment the free allowance changed.
auth_shape.never_contains: no key material, no customer id, no upstream/billing detail.

added: _algovault.auth — additive. Emitted on BOTH surfaces here: the chat_knowledge MCP tool and POST /api/chat, which already resolves a license (SEC-03) and answers Cache-Control: no-store, so a per-caller member is safe on the HTTP twin.
changed_this_wave.unchanged: quota_remaining, bundle_version, bundle_generated_at and the entire error_contract keep their names and semantics.
